svg.aria-label: Seven questions to pass before a single line of code — fail any one and the project doesn't start
svg.title: Seven questions to pass before a single line of code — fail any one and the project doesn't start

text.font-family: Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif

svg.text: 1 Did this problem actually bother me last week?

text.font-family: Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif
Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif

svg.text: 2 Could a notes app, a spreadsheet, or an existing app do it?

text.font-family: Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif
Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif

svg.text: 3 Is there a trigger that opens it at least once a day?

text.font-family: Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif
Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif
Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif
Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif

Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif

svg.text: 6 Do the key inputs (external APIs, data) actually exist?

text.font-family: Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif
Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif

svg.text: 7 Is the distribution channel actually open?

text.font-family: Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif
Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif

svg.text: Only after all seven does code get written
